Sample.warning: The qualitative sample size (total_n) was not reported in this section.

Type.evidence_source: Although not explicitly stated, the presence of direct patient quotes suggests primary data collection: ". . . the psychiatrist I was dealing with was phenomenally abusive and also seemed to be more concerned with, I guess, displaying his power and authority, and I suppose his superiority. He liked to play games, like I told him I wanted to leave that hospital and go try another one, so he said 'Sure, you're welcome to sign yourself out at any time, but I'm going to leave an order there to have you committed if you do', and he just wanted to play games with me." (15:1431)

Area.evidence_source: Some participants noted that staff engaged in disrespectful behavior toward patients such as failing to provide a consultation, making sarcastic remarks, or ignoring the patients. This perception of disrespectful behavior also contributed to negative experiences and fragmented pathways to care.
